title: Rescale-Zero-One 1D
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Input Layer Normalizations/Rescale_Zero_One_1D.md
text: 具有 rescale-zero-one 归一化的一维输入层，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Layer} 指定对应的层对象；{Data format} 指定输入数据的格式、{Output minimum} 用于范围检查的最小输出值、{Output maximum} 用于范围检查的最大输出值、{Output data type} 输出数据类型、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型、{Output integer rounding mode} 指定定点输出转换操作的舍入模式、{Output saturate on integer overflow} 输出转换操作的溢出操作方式、{Min} 指定最小值的数据类型、{Max} 指定最大值的数据类型、{Divide output} 指定除法输出的数据类型、{Subtract Min Accumulator} 指定 SubtractMin 模块的累加器数据类型、{Internal integer rounding mode} 指定内部定点运算的舍入模式、{Internal saturate on integer overflow} 指定内部模块操作的溢出操作方式、{Sample time} 用于指定采样时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 归一化后的输出数据 2-dimensional array | 1-dimensional array

params.name: Layer
params.values: 对应的层对象 layerObject (default) | featureInputLayer object | sequenceInputLayer object

params.name: Data format
params.values: 输入数据的格式 CT (default) | C

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: 用于范围检查的最小输出值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: 用于范围检查的最大输出值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Keep LSB | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as accumulator |

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on

params.name: Output integer rounding mode
params.values: 定点输出转换操作的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Output saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 输出转换操作的溢出操作方式 off (default) | on

params.name: Min
params.values: 最小值的数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via back propagation (default) | Inherit: Inherit from ’Constant value’ |

params.name: Max
params.values: 最大值的数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via back propagation (default) | Inherit: Inherit from ’Constant value’ |

params.name: Divide output
params.values: 除法输出的数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Match scaling | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Subtract Min Accumulator
params.values: SubtractMin 模块的累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Internal integer rounding mode
params.values: 内部定点运算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Internal saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 内部模块操作的溢出操作方式 off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 用于指定采样时间的选项 -1 (default) | scalar
